messages:
Leah: Heads up — Priya starts Mon 3/30. Can we get a concierge-style first-week agenda + 30/60/90 expectations and a short IT/laptop access checklist? Want something I can send to her and her manager.
Ben (People Ops): Sure — will draft. Quick q: full remote or hybrid?
Leah: Fully remote (PST). Laptop shipped overnight. Needs VPN + GCP access.
Ben (People Ops): Ok. Draft below — feel free to tweak.
Ben (People Ops): Day 1 (Mon):
- 09:30am Welcome + expectations (30m) w/Leah
- 10:15am HR onboarding & benefits Qs (30m)
- 11:00am IT setup session (30m) — VPN, SSO, MFA, laptop imaging
- 12:00pm Virtual team lunch (30–45m)
- 14:00pm Buddy pairing: run local dev env (1h)
- End of day: quick sync + blockers
Ben (People Ops): Day 2–3:
- Product deep-dive & docs (2h)
- Infra walkthrough (1h)
- Sandbox task: clone + run tests, open a tiny PR
Ben (People Ops): Day 4–5:
- Start on first small ticket with buddy pairing (goal: shipping a tiny change)
- 1:1 with manager to align 30/60/90 + success metrics
Ben (People Ops): Quick dev environment checklist to include in the one-pager:
- Clone main repos and run tests: `git clone ... && make test`
- Ensure SSH key added to infra repo
- Confirm Okta SSO + MFA enrolled
- VPN profile installed and tested
- Access to Redwood Console (read-only) and dev GCP project
- Request dedicated test GPU access if working on model infra
Ben (People Ops): High-level 30/60/90 (one-paragraph style):
- 30 days: Fully onboarded — env stable, one small bug/feature shipped, onboarding eval passed.
- 60 days: Independent feature ownership on a medium task, docs published, regular syncs with cross-team partners.
- 90 days: Lead a small rollout or perf/cost improvement, propose 1–2 optimizations, ownership signal shown.
Aisha (IT): IT checklist (concise):
- Create GSuite and Okta accounts (done)
- Enforce MFA + enroll hardware token if requested
- Provision VPN and check connectivity from remote IPs
- Grant project-level roles in GCP (dev)
- Add SSH key to infra repo and CI access group
- Open support ticket if GPU access required (inc. queue ETA)
Sam (Eng Buddy): I’ll be buddy. Happy to pair Mon/Wed 10–11am PST to get Priya running. Priya — ping me when laptop arrives :wave:
hr-bot: Welcome packet and policy links sent to priya@example.com (automated)
Leah: This looks great. Ben — can you put this into a one-page PDF + include POCs (IT: Aisha, Buddy: Sam, Security: sec-oncall)?
Ben (People Ops): Yep — will produce a one-pager and drop it here by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
Leah: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround!
